selections.title: Circle of Death — actual application receiver

measurements.gpu_bytes: incremental rendering-server texture and buffer allocation in isolated measurement; shared cached resources may already be resident
measurements.sample_us: median CPU callback time; not total GPU frame time
measurements.disk_bytes: entry file bytes; shared dependency files are counted once in package_disk_bytes

production_construction.scope: Explicit preparation-time source operands; consumer projects actual facts; not a runtime discovery pass

actor_history_preparation.scope: Existing actual actor packet; one private allocation/binding unit per call; no invented history

measured_alternatives.selection: Unselected; no automatic substitution for recorded/default approaches
